verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a project-management and issue-tracking product that connects to external coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code and Codex CLI through its MCP server. It does not itself run AI coding agent sessions, so restoring an agent session to a previous checkpoint is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Shortcut shipping agent sessions or a checkpoint history.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
